description: This file defines the Weight class in the Opencart system, responsible for handling weight conversions, formatting, and retrieval of weight unit data, utilizing database queries and in-memory cache.

classes.name: Weight
classes.description: A class for handling weight conversions, formatting, and retrieving weight units in the Opencart system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Weight object by fetching weight class data from the database based on the current language setting.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts a weight value from one weight class to another.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats a weight value into a string with specified decimal and thousand separators, appending the unit.

methods.name: getUnit
methods.description: Retrieves the unit string for a specified weight class ID.
